text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch... Everyone was hyping up that new DAW, so I had high hopes, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The effects and everything else are bottom-of-the-barrel trash. Don't go making garbage that treats it like 'good enough as long as it's mixed.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Calling this the best... makes me question the taste of everyone who praised it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even just tweaking the equalizer would make it way better, y'know...
Maybe I'll write some code for a plugin...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Air Shakur got so engrossed in tuning her music software that she skipped training.
